classes.EXACT_OR_NORMALIZED_RECOVERY: After only predeclared normalization of identifiers and presentation order, the focal claim and all identity-relevant typed nodes, relations, temporal commitments, and boundary commitments align with the retained record.
classes.COMPATIBLE_ALTERNATIVE_DECOMPOSITION: The new record preserves the same source-level commitments but partitions or names intermediate structure differently without changing the relevant dependency or temporal content.
classes.SUBSTANTIVE_DISAGREEMENT: The new record asserts, omits, or reverses at least one source-level commitment that changes an identity-relevant role, relation, temporal dependency, or system-boundary judgment.
classes.ABSTENTION_OR_UNDERDETERMINED: The model declines or cannot resolve the focal claim or required structural content from the source.

normalization_allowed: synonymous labels when the typed role and relation are unchanged
normalization_forbidden: consulting the retained answer before classification
reporting: no single aggregate score without the case ledger
